A DOI hit is NOT verification: Crossref returns its best guess for any query, so the tier is gated on title similarity and year agreement. An earlier version of this module reported 'matched a DOI' without gating and claimed 4/4 for entries whose similarity scores were 0.2-1.0 and only one of which agreed on year.
